name: std::basic_stringbuf<CharT,Traits,Allocator>::swap
intro:
Swaps the state and the contents of *this and rhs.

The behavior is undefined if Allocator does not propagate on swap and the allocators of *this and other are unequal.


(since C++11)

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text:
May throw implementation-defined exceptions.


(since C++11)
(until C++20)

noexcept specification:  
noexcept(std::allocator_traits<Allocator>::propagate_on_container_swap::value

|| std::allocator_traits<Allocator>::is_always_equal::value)

(since C++20)

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: This function is called automatically when swapping std::stringstream objects. It is rarely necessary to call it directly.

examples.output:
Before swap: one = "one", two = "two".
After  swap: one = "two", two = "one".

summary: Swaps the state and the contents of *this and rhs.
